name: badge
title: Badge
description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.
accessibilityNotes: Renders a plain `<span>` (see `packages/shadcn/ui/badge/badge.marko`) with no implicit ARIA role — it's a visual label, not an interactive control.
A badge conveying status information should not rely on color alone; pair it with text (as in the status examples) so the meaning survives for users who can't perceive color.

When a badge wraps interactive content, such as the link pattern above, the interactive element itself (`<a>`, `<button>`) carries the accessibility semantics and keyboard behavior — the badge only supplies styling.

examples.title: Status examples
examples.source:

Active Pending Failed Draft
examples.description: Badges are a common way to surface state, such as the status of a record.

examples.title: With icon
examples.source:
import Badge from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/badge/badge.marko";

<Badge variant="secondary">
  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/>
  </svg>
  Verified
</Badge>
examples.description: Render an icon alongside the badge text. Use `data-icon="inline-start"` to render the icon on the left and `data-icon="inline-end"` to render the icon on the right.

examples.title: With spinner
examples.source:
import Badge from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/badge/badge.marko"; import Spinner from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/spinner/spinner.marko";
Deleting Generating
examples.description: Render a spinner inside the badge. Add `data-icon="inline-start"` or `data-icon="inline-end"` to the spinner, same as an icon.

examples.title: Link
examples.source: import Badge from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/badge/badge.marko"; import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko"; Open Link
examples.description: Pass `href` and the badge renders as a real `<a>` with the same styling — the Marko equivalent of shadcn's `asChild`. Nesting an `<a>` inside the badge, as this demo does, also works, and the badge's `[a]:hover:` styles already target a child link.

examples.title: Numeric
examples.source:
import Badge from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/badge/badge.marko";
8 99+
examples.description: Badges also work well for short counts, like unread totals.

Blue Green Sky Purple Red
examples.description: Customize a badge's colors by adding classes such as `bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-800` directly to the `Badge` component.
